characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (Film/Book)
characters.summary: Fluffy is a giant three-headed dog employed as a guardian beast. He attacks intruders with his three sets of jaws and immense physical strength, but is vulnerable to falling asleep when lulled by music.

techniques: Biting and snapping with three heads

weaknesses: Falls fast asleep when lulled by music or played instruments
mobility: Walking and running on four legs
limitations: Lacks intelligence beyond basic guard animal instincts
Immobile or restricted in movement while guarding the trapdoor

sources.supports: Information on Fluffy's three heads, role as guard dog, and weakness to music.

feats.claim: Guarded the trapdoor leading to the Philosopher's Stone on the third floor corridor.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

feats.claim: Was successfully subdued and put to sleep by Harry, Ron, and Hermione using a harp.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
notableResults.note: Intruders escaped after putting Fluffy to sleep with music.

campaignTags.claim: Fluffy is a monstrously large three-headed dog, significantly larger than normal canine specimens.

unknowns: Exact origin outside of being bought from a Greek chap in a pub by Hagrid.

characters.summary: Fred Weasley is a skilled prankster, inventor, and combatant who fights using magical pranks, standard jinxes, and inventive joke shop merchandise alongside his twin brother George.

techniques: Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes magical devices and products

weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical harm like any ordinary human wizard
limitations: Relies on standard human physical durability and wand-based magic casting

sources.supports: Fred Weasley's magical skills, participation in battles, and co-founding of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Department of Mysteries and the Battle of the Astronomy Tower.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Half-Blood Prince

feats.claim: Successfully manufactured and sold protective Shield Hats to the Ministry of Magic.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Dumbledore's Army against Death Eaters at the Ministry.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Killed in an explosion during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes magical items and trick products from Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes in combat and defense.
Co-invented numerous magical joke items and protective gear like Shield Hats.

unknowns: Precise spell accuracy compared to dedicated duelists like aurors.

characters.summary: Gellert Grindelwald is a supremely powerful, charismatic, and radical dark wizard who relies on devastating offensive spellcasting, tactical manipulation, and wide-area destructive magic.

techniques: Powerful elemental and offensive charm work

weaknesses: Overconfidence in his vision and persuasive charisma
limitations: Bound by the blood pact with Albus Dumbledore preventing them from fighting each other directly (prior to its destruction).

sources.supports: Grindelwald's magical prowess, spells used, and history as a powerful dark wizard.

feats.claim: Created a massive blue fire ring in Paris that tested the loyalty of followers and killed Aurors.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Albus Dumbledore in their legendary 1945 duel.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them / The Crimes of Grindelwald
notableResults.note: Frequently overpowered multiple trained aurors simultaneously.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated in their historic duel in 1945.

campaignTags.claim: Master dark wizard capable of complex and devastating magical spellcasting without requiring verbal components.
Can generate and manipulate Protego Diaboli, a massive, sentient circle of blue flame that incinerates opponents.

unknowns: The exact details of every duel fought during his global campaign of terror.

characters.summary: This version of Gellert Grindelwald wields the Elder Wand, amplifying his already formidable spellcasting power, destructive range, and dueling dominance to legendary levels.

techniques: Unstoppable offensive curse barrages boosted by the Elder Wand

mechanisms: Impenetrable magical barriers powered by the Elder Wand

weaknesses: Allegiance of the Elder Wand can shift if the current master is disarmed or defeated
limitations: Vulnerable to the same psychological blind spots and the blood pact constraint.
characters.formDifferences: Gains a massive amplification in spell power, destructive scope, and magical projection due to possessing the Elder Wand.

sources.supports: The power enhancements granted by the Elder Wand to its master.
Grindelwald's ownership and usage of the Elder Wand.

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
notableResults.note: Easily dispatched groups of pursuers using the amplified power of the Elder Wand.

campaignTags.claim: Wields master-level magic amplified significantly by the Elder Wand.
Possesses the Elder Wand, one of the Deathly Hallows.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of destructive output when fully utilizing the Elder Wand without restraint.

characters.summary: George Weasley is an experienced wizard, inventor, and prankster who relies on clever trick items, standard combat hexes, and tactical teamwork alongside his brother Fred.
weaknesses: Suffers from the loss of his left ear, which impacts his balance and situational awareness in combat.
limitations: Lost his left ear permanently during the Seven Potters battle.

sources.supports: George Weasley's magical abilities, injuries in combat, and co-ownership of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Seven Potters, sustaining severe injury from Sectumsempra.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

feats.claim: Participated in the final defense of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Successfully helped repel Death Eaters during Ministry skirmishes.

campaignTags.claim: Equipped with specialized trick items and magical defense products.
Co-created magical pranks and tactical defense apparel like Shield Hats.

unknowns: Long-term combat effectiveness post-injury compared to his peak pre-injury state.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
characters.summary: Gilderoy Lockhart is a fraudulent wizard who relies almost entirely on the Memory Charm (Obliviate) to steal the achievements of others, possessing virtually no genuine combat competence.
weaknesses: Utterly incompetent in actual combat and defensive magic
limitations: Fails at standard spells, famously botching a simple bone-mending charm and backfiring his own Memory Charm.

sources.supports: Lockhart's reliance on Obliviate and his lack of genuine dueling ability.

feats.claim: Successfully wiped the memories of numerous accomplished wizards and witches to steal their life stories.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Backfired his own broken wand when attempting to cast Obliviate on Harry and Ron, erasing his own memory.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient in casting the Memory Charm (Obliviate) on unsuspecting targets.

unknowns: Whether his memory ever fully recovered post-St. Mungo's treatment.

characters.summary: Ginny Weasley is a fierce and capable witch skilled in offensive hexes, Bat-Bogey curses, and broomstick flight, fighting actively in major engagements against Death Eaters.

techniques: Reducto and other powerful offensive jinxes

limitations: Restricted by standard human endurance and wand range limitations.

sources.supports: Ginny Weasley's magical capabilities, Dumbledore's Army membership, and dueling feats.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Department of Mysteries, the Astronomy Tower, and the Battle of Hogwarts.
Noted for exceptionally proficient use of the Bat-Bogey Curse against bullies and opponents.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Successfully survived and fought off Death Eaters during multiple mass engagements.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient witch capable of advanced offensive and defensive spellcasting.

unknowns: Her exact dueling grade or formal post-school Auror status.

characters.summary: Godric Gryffindor was a legendary medieval wizard, master duelist, and co-founder of Hogwarts, wielding powerful swordplay alongside peerless spellcasting.

techniques: Expert swordsmanship with the Sword of Gryffindor

mechanisms: Goblin-made enchanted sword that absorbs strength

weaknesses: No documented weaknesses outside of historical mortality
limitations: Historical figure who died long before the modern era.

sources.supports: Godric Gryffindor's historical feats as a co-founder and master duelist.

feats.claim: Co-founded Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
Commissioned the creation of the Sword of Gryffindor from Ragnuk the First.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.note: Their ideological split led to Slytherin's departure from Hogwarts without a definitive fatal duel recorded.

campaignTags.claim: One of the greatest historical wizards and spellcasters of the medieval era.
Wielded the Sword of Gryffindor, a goblin-made blade imbued with magical properties.

unknowns: Exact details of his personal dueling record.

characters.summary: Gregory Goyle is a bulky, thuggish Slytherin student who relies on brute physical intimidation, heavy blunt force, and dark arts learned late in his schooling.
weaknesses: Low intelligence and poor tactical reasoning
limitations: Inability to control the destructive Fiendfyre he summoned, leading to his own undoing.

sources.supports: Goyle's physical description, use of dark magic, and role as Draco Malfoy's henchman.

feats.claim: Attacked Harry, Ron, and Hermione in the Room of Requirement using Fiendfyre.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Subdued by Hermione and Ron during the Room of Requirement confrontation.

campaignTags.claim: Capable of casting advanced and destructive dark magic such as Fiendfyre.
Summoned Fiendfyre, a cursed, uncontrollable magical fire taking the shape of ferocious beasts.

unknowns: How he managed to master Fiendfyre given his generally poor academic performance.

characters.summary: Griphook is a cunning goblin banker and operative who relies on goblin-made weaponry, knowledge of subterranean security, and tactical pragmatism.

mechanisms: Stealth and knowledge of Gringotts defenses

weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical injury and wand magic like any goblin or human
limitations: Lacks access to wizarding wand magic, relying instead on cunning and goblin steel.

sources.supports: Griphook's role at Gringotts and participation in the vault break-in.

feats.claim: Helped Harry, Ron, and Hermione infiltrate Bellatrix Lestrange's high-security vault at Gringotts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Successfully bypassed security dragons and guards to breach the vault.

campaignTags.claim: Expertly navigated Gringotts bank security and vaults during a high-stakes heist.

unknowns: Exact fate and status after fleeing with the Sword of Gryffindor during the break-in.
